articles.title: Why Minnesota is empowering local banks to fight Wall Street for crypto revenue
articles.snippet: A local banker told CoinDesk that in light of Wall Street’s aggressive push into the crypto industry, Minnesota's financial institutions could not afford to remain on the sidelines.

articles.title: Tom Emmer brushes off law enforcement concerns over Clarity Act
articles.snippet: House Majority Whip Tom Emmer said concerns from law enforcement groups about crypto developer protections are being overstated.

articles.title: Polymarket aims for prediction market approval in Japan by 2030
articles.snippet: Mike Eidlin, head of Japan at cryptocurrency exchange Jupiter, is leading Polymarket's efforts, according to reports.

articles.title: Verus bridge exploiter returns $8.5M after bounty offer
articles.snippet: The hacker behind the Verus bridge exploit returned 75% of the stolen funds as part of a recovery deal negotiated with the protocol days after the incident.

articles.title: Galaxy’s Novogratz speaks in court over failed $1.2B BitGo deal: Report
articles.snippet: Galaxy Digital’s Mike Novogratz reportedly told a court the SEC made it “very difficult” to complete a planned 2021 merger with BitGo.
